files.content:
# Examples/Doc editor insert panel

A side-by-side panel: vertical rail, grid and a details pane via useActiveEmoji().

Install the v5 emoji-picker-react candidate, import app.css and picker.css, then render <Shell className="editor-picker" />. For CSS Modules, import picker.module.css and pass styles.picker as className. The component includes its app context; adapt its insertion callback to your product.
